translations.idiomatic: Today's foes cannot be resisted unless we master what they master; even the least informed among us knows this—or ought to.

sentences.zh: 乃至緊要關鍵，意見頓相背，往往陳義甚高，鄙洋務為不足言，抑或苟安為計，覺和局之深可恃。

translations.literal: Yet at the critical juncture views suddenly oppose each other; often principles are stated very loftily and foreign affairs are disdained as unworthy of mention, or else ease is taken as the plan and peace is felt deeply reliable.
translations.idiomatic: Yet at the decisive moment opinions collide: some hold forth in lofty principle and dismiss foreign affairs as beneath mention, while others seek only ease and treat the peace as wholly secure.

sentences.zh: 是以歷來練兵、造船、習器、天文、算學諸事，每興一議而阻之者多，即就一事而為之者非其實。

translations.literal: Therefore, over the years, in matters of training troops, building ships, practicing with weapons, astronomy, and mathematics, whenever one proposal is raised many obstruct it, and even when one matter is undertaken it is not done in earnest.
translations.idiomatic: Hence over the years, whether the topic is training troops, building ships, mastering arms, astronomy, or mathematics, each new proposal meets many obstructions, and even when something is attempted it is rarely pursued in earnest.

sentences.zh: 至於無成，則不咎其阻撓之故，而責創議之人；

translations.literal: When nothing is achieved, they do not blame the obstruction but blame those who proposed;
translations.idiomatic: When nothing is achieved, blame falls not on those who obstructed but on those who proposed;

sentences.zh: 甚至局外紛紛論說，以國家經營自立之計，而指為敷衍洋人。

translations.literal: Even to the point that outsiders chatter, taking the nation's plan for self-reliance and calling it placating foreigners.
translations.idiomatic: Until outsiders loudly declare that the state's program of self-reliance is nothing but placating foreigners.

sentences.zh: 所見之誤，竟至於此！

translations.literal: The error of view reaches even to this!
translations.idiomatic: Misjudgment has sunk to this depth!

sentences.zh: 今日本擾台之役業經議結，日本尚非法、英、俄、美之比，此事本屬無名之師，已幾幾震動全局，費盡筆爭舌戰，始就範圍。

translations.literal: Now the Japanese disturbance of Taiwan has already been settled by negotiation; Japan is not yet comparable to France, Britain, Russia, or America; this affair was originally aggression without just cause and already nearly shook the whole situation; only after exhausting pen and tongue did it finally fall within bounds.
translations.idiomatic: The Japanese incursion against Taiwan has now been settled by negotiation. Japan is not yet the equal of France, Britain, Russia, or America, and this was in origin an unjust war—yet it nearly convulsed the whole realm and required every argument of pen and tongue before it could be brought within bounds.

sentences.zh: 若泰西強大各國環而相伺，得中國一無理之端，藉為名義，構兵而來，更不知如何要挾，如何挽回？

translations.literal: If the powerful nations of the West surround us and watch, and gain one unreasonable point from China as a pretext to raise troops and come, who knows how they would coerce us or how we could remedy it?
translations.idiomatic: If the great Western powers, encircling us in watchful rivalry, raise armies on any unjust pretext China affords, who can say how far their coercion would go—or how we might recover?

sentences.zh: 言念及此，真有食不下嚥者，則自強之計尚可須臾緩哉？

translations.literal: When I think of this, I truly am one who cannot swallow his food—can the plan for self-strengthening still be delayed even for a moment?
translations.idiomatic: The thought alone steals my appetite—can self-strengthening be deferred even for an instant?

sentences.zh: 此總理衙門奏請飭令會議諸條，實為緊要關係，不可不及早切實籌辦者也。

translations.literal: These items for which the Zongli Yamen memorial requests that an edict order conference are truly critically related and cannot but be planned early and in earnest.
translations.idiomatic: The items on which the Zongli Yamen now asks that an edict order deliberation are critically connected to our fate and must be planned early and in earnest.

sentences.zh: 今計各疆吏遵旨籌議，指日將依限上陳，如飭下廷議，非向來會議事件可比，應由各王大臣期定數日，詳細籌商，將事之本末始終，一律貫澈，利害之輕重，條議之行止，辦法切實，折中定見，無蹈從前會議故習。

translations.literal: The plan now is that each frontier governor, obeying the edict, will confer and report within the deadline; if an edict orders court deliberation, this cannot be compared with conference matters in the past—it should be fixed for several days by the princes and ministers for detailed consultation, so that the beginning, middle, and end of each matter are uniformly understood, the weight of advantage and harm and whether each provision should proceed or stop are determined, methods are substantive, a balanced decision is fixed, and the bad habits of past conferences are not repeated.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier governors are now preparing reports under edict and will soon submit them on deadline. If the matter goes to deliberation at court, it must not be treated like ordinary conference business: the princes and senior ministers should set aside several days for thorough consultation, follow each issue from first to last, weigh benefits against harms, decide which provisions to adopt or reject, fix practicable methods and a balanced consensus—and break with the old habits of empty conference.

sentences.zh: 如今日議之行之，而異日不能同心堅持，則不如不辦。

translations.literal: If what is discussed and implemented today cannot be upheld with one heart tomorrow, then it is better not to do it.
translations.idiomatic: If what we adopt today cannot be upheld with common resolve tomorrow, it is better not to adopt it at all.

sentences.zh: 如事雖議行，而名是實非，徒為開銷帑需，增益各省人員差使名目，亦不如不辦。

translations.literal: If matters are discussed and implemented but in name yes and in fact no, merely opening treasury expenditures and adding provincial personnel and commission titles, that too is better not done.
translations.idiomatic: If reforms are approved in name but hollow in fact—merely draining the treasury and multiplying provincial posts and sinecures—it is likewise better not to proceed.

sentences.zh: 度勢揆時，料敵審己，實有萬萬不能不辦之勢，亦實有萬萬不可再誤之機。

translations.literal: Measure the trend and appraise the time, estimate the enemy and examine oneself—there truly is the momentum of ten thousand times ten thousand things that cannot but be done, and truly there is the juncture of ten thousand times ten thousand that cannot be mistaken again.
translations.idiomatic: To read the trend of the times, weigh the enemy, and examine ourselves is to see a momentum in which certain measures simply must be taken—and a moment in which error cannot be risked again.

sentences.zh: 一誤即不能復更，不辦即不堪設想。

translations.literal: One mistake then cannot be corrected; failure to act then is beyond imagining.
translations.idiomatic: One mistake cannot be undone; failure to act is beyond imagining.

sentences.zh: 總理衙門摺內所謂'必須上下一心，內外一心，局中局外一心，且歷久永遠一心'，即此意也。

translations.literal: What the Zongli Yamen memorial calls 'must have one heart above and below, within and without, inside and outside the bureaus—and one heart enduring through long years' means exactly this.
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen memorial's phrase—that 'above and below, within and without, inside and outside the bureaus, and through long years to come, all must be of one mind'—means precisely this.

sentences.zh: 而大本所在，尤望我皇上切念而健行之。

translations.literal: And in this fundamental matter especially, I earnestly hope Your Majesty will fix it in mind and vigorously pursue it.
translations.idiomatic: On this fundamental point above all, I earnestly hope Your Majesty will keep it constantly in mind and vigorously carry it through.

sentences.zh: 總理衙門承辦之事，能否維持，全視實力之能否深恃。

translations.literal: Whether what the Zongli Yamen undertakes can be sustained depends entirely on whether real strength can be deeply relied upon.
translations.idiomatic: Whether what the Zongli Yamen undertakes can be sustained depends entirely on whether the state can truly rely on its own strength.

sentences.zh: 必確有可戰可守之實，庶可握不戰之勝。

translations.literal: Only with solid capacity to fight and to hold can one grasp victory without fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Only with solid capacity to fight and to hold can one secure victory without fighting.

sentences.zh: 惟我皇上念茲在茲，則在事諸臣之苦心，自能上邀宸鑑。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty keeps this constantly in mind, the devoted efforts of the ministers charged with the work will naturally win the imperial discernment.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty keeps this constantly in mind, the devoted labors of the ministers charged with the work will naturally win the imperial discernment.

sentences.zh: 凡百臣工亦人人有求知此事共籌此事之心，其才識智力必有百倍於臣者。

translations.literal: All officials too will each have the heart to inquire into this matter and jointly plan it, and there will surely be those whose talent and intelligence exceed mine a hundredfold.
translations.idiomatic: Every official will share the will to study this matter and plan it together, and there will surely be men whose talent and judgment exceed mine a hundredfold.

sentences.zh: 否則支持既難，變更不免，變而復合，痛心之端，必且百倍今日，非臣之所忍言矣。

translations.literal: Otherwise support will be hard to sustain, change will be unavoidable; if affairs change and then revert, the causes of anguish will surely exceed today's a hundredfold—not what your servant can bear to speak of.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise support will prove impossible, change will become unavoidable, and if policy shifts and then reverts, the sources of anguish will surely exceed today's a hundredfold—more than your servant can bear to speak of.

sentences.zh: 」疏上，未幾卒。

translations.literal: ' The memorial was submitted; before long he died.
translations.idiomatic: ' The memorial was submitted; before long he died.

sentences.zh: 溫詔賜卹，稱其「清正持躬，精詳謀國，忠純亮直，誠懇公明，為國家股肱心膂之臣」，贈太傅，予騎都尉世職，入祀賢良祠，賜銀三千兩治喪，遣貝勒載澂奠醊，諡文忠，歸葬盛京，命將軍崇實往賜祭。

translations.literal: A warm edict granted condolence gifts, praising him as 'upright in personal conduct, meticulous in planning for the state, loyal, pure, bright, and straight, sincere and public-spirited—a minister who was the state's arms and backbone'; posthumously made Grand Tutor, granted the hereditary office of Cavalry Commandant, entered for worship at the Shrine of Worthies, granted three thousand taels of silver for funeral expenses, sent Prince Zaichen to offer libations, posthumous title Wenzhong, buried at Shengjing, ordered General Chongshi to go and grant sacrificial offerings.
translations.idiomatic: A warm edict granted condolence gifts, praising him as 'upright in conduct, meticulous in statecraft, loyal, pure, bright, and straight, sincere and public-spirited—a minister who was the state's arms and backbone.' He was posthumously made Grand Tutor, granted the hereditary office of Cavalry Commandant, and entered for worship at the Shrine of Worthies; three thousand taels of silver were granted for his funeral, Prince Zaichen was sent to offer libations, his posthumous title was Wenzhong, he was buried at Shengjing, and General Chongshi was ordered to go and grant sacrificial offerings.

sentences.zh: 十五年，皇太后歸政，追念前勞，賜祭一壇。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, when the Empress Dowager returned power, recalling his earlier service, one altar of sacrifices was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, when the Empress Dowager returned power to the throne, she recalled his earlier service and granted one altar of sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 文祥忠勤，為中興樞臣之冠。

translations.literal: Wen Xiang was loyal and diligent, the foremost minister of the Restoration at the center of power.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Xiang was loyal and diligent—the foremost minister of the Restoration at the center of power.

sentences.zh: 清操絕人，家如寒素。

translations.literal: His integrity surpassed others; his household was like that of the poor and plain.
translations.idiomatic: His integrity surpassed others, and his household lived in plain poverty.

sentences.zh: 謀國深遠，當新疆軍事漸定，與俄國議交還伊犁，大學士左宗棠引以自任，文祥力主之，奏請專任。

translations.literal: He planned for the state with far sight. When military affairs in Xinjiang were gradually settled and negotiations with Russia began over returning Ili, Grand Secretary Zuo Zongtang took the responsibility upon himself; Wen Xiang strongly supported him and memorialized asking that Zuo be solely entrusted with the task.
translations.idiomatic: He planned for the state with far sight. When military affairs in Xinjiang were gradually settled and negotiations with Russia began over the return of Ili, Grand Secretary Zuo Zongtang took the mission upon himself; Wen Xiang strongly supported him and memorialized asking that Zuo be solely entrusted with it.

sentences.zh: 文祥既歿，後乃遣侍郎崇厚赴俄國，為所迫脅，擅允條款，朝論譁然。

translations.literal: After Wen Xiang's death, Vice Minister Chonghou was later sent to Russia; coerced, he presumptuously agreed to the terms, and court opinion erupted in uproar.
translations.idiomatic: After Wen Xiang died, Vice Minister Chonghou was later sent to Russia; under coercion he presumptuously agreed to the terms, and court opinion erupted in uproar.

sentences.zh: 譴罪崇厚，易以曾紀澤往，久之乃定議，倖免大釁。

translations.literal: Chonghou was condemned and punished; Zeng Jize was sent in his place; only after a long time was an agreement settled, narrowly avoiding a great breach.
translations.idiomatic: Chonghou was condemned and punished, and Zeng Jize was sent in his place; only after a long delay was an agreement settled, narrowly avoiding a grave rupture.

sentences.zh: 法越事起，和戰屢更，以海防疏，不能大創敵，遷就結局。

translations.literal: When the Franco-Vietnamese affair arose, peace and war alternated repeatedly; coastal defenses were lax and the enemy could not be heavily struck; the settlement was a compromise.
translations.idiomatic: When the Franco-Vietnamese conflict arose, peace and war alternated repeatedly; coastal defenses were lax, the enemy could not be heavily struck, and the settlement was a compromise.

sentences.zh: 及興海軍，未能竭全力以成之，卒挫於日本。

translations.literal: When a navy was raised, full effort could not be poured into completing it, and in the end it was defeated by Japan.
translations.idiomatic: When a navy was raised, the state could not pour full effort into completing it, and in the end it was broken by Japan.

sentences.zh: 皆如文祥所慮，而朝局數變，日以多事矣。

translations.literal: All were as Wen Xiang had feared, and the court situation changed repeatedly, growing more troubled day by day.
translations.idiomatic: All unfolded as Wen Xiang had feared, while the court situation shifted again and again and grew more troubled day by day.

sentences.zh: 子熙治，以員外郎襲騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: His son Xizhi inherited the hereditary Cavalry Commandant office as a department director.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xizhi inherited the hereditary office of Cavalry Commandant as a department director.

sentences.zh: 寶鋆，字佩蘅，索綽絡氏，滿洲鑲白旗人，世居吉林。

translations.literal: Bao Yun, styled Peiheng, of the Suochiluo clan, a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner, with his family long residing in Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Yun, whose style was Peiheng, belonged to the Suochiluo clan and came from the Manchu Bordered White Banner; his family had long resided in Jilin.

sentences.zh: 道光十八年進士，授禮部主事，擢中允。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the eighteenth year of Daoguang, appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Rites, promoted to reader-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of the eighteenth year of Daoguang, he was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Rites and promoted to reader-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 三遷侍讀學士。

translations.literal: Thrice promoted to attendant reader.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted three times to attendant reader.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，粵匪竄兩湖，寶鋆疏請鄰近諸省力行堅壁清野之策。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng, when Guangdong bandits raided into the Two Hu, Bao Yun memorialized asking neighboring provinces to earnestly apply the strategy of strengthening walls and clearing the countryside.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng, when Guangdong rebels raided into Hunan and Hubei, Bao Yun memorialized asking neighboring provinces to earnestly apply the strategy of strengthening walls and clearing the countryside.

sentences.zh: 四年，命往三音諾顏部賜奠，謝絕餽贐，外籓敬之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, ordered to go to the Sain Noyan department to grant sacrificial offerings; he declined gifts, and the outer vassals respected him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was ordered to go to the Sain Noyan department to grant sacrificial offerings; he declined gifts, and the outer vassals respected him.

sentences.zh: 擢內閣學士。

translations.literal: Promoted to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 五年，遷禮部侍郎，兼正紅旗蒙古副都統，調戶部。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, transferred to vice minister of Rites, concurrently vice commander of the Mongol Plain Red Banner, transferred to Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to vice minister of Rites, concurrently made vice commander of the Mongol Plain Red Banner, and then transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 八年，典浙江鄉試，以廣額加中官生一名，坐違制，鐫一級留任，文宗諭「寶鋆素以果敢自命，亦同瞻徇」，特嚴斥焉。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he presided over the Zhejiang provincial examination; for expanding quotas and adding one gongsheng candidate, he was guilty of violating regulations, struck one rank but retained office; Emperor Wenzong edicted 'Bao Yun has always styled himself bold and resolute—yet he too showed favoritism,' and specially rebuked him sternly.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he presided over the Zhejiang provincial examination; for expanding quotas and adding one gongsheng candidate he was found in violation of regulations, struck one rank but retained office. Emperor Wenzong edicted, 'Bao Yun has always styled himself bold and resolute—yet he too showed favoritism,' and rebuked him with special severity.

sentences.zh: 十年，命赴天津驗收海運漕糧，复赴通州察視，迭疏請定杜弊章程，並劾監督貽誤，如所請行。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, ordered to go to Tianjin to inspect receipt of grain shipped by sea, then to Tongzhou to inspect; he repeatedly memorialized asking that rules to stop abuses be fixed, and impeached supervisors for dereliction; as he requested, it was carried out.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was ordered to Tianjin to inspect receipt of grain shipped by sea, then to Tongzhou to inspect the route; he repeatedly memorialized asking that rules to stop abuses be fixed and impeached supervisors for dereliction, and his requests were carried out.

sentences.zh: 任總管內務府大臣，署理戶部三庫事務，會辦京城巡防。

translations.literal: He served as Superintendent of the Imperial Household Department, acted in managing the three treasuries of Revenue, and jointly handled capital patrol defense.
translations.idiomatic: He served as superintendent of the Imperial Household Department, acted in managing the three treasuries of the Ministry of Revenue, and jointly handled capital patrol defense.

sentences.zh: 時英法聯軍內犯，車駕幸熱河，既至，命提庫帑二十萬兩修葺行宮。

translations.literal: When the Anglo-French allied armies invaded inland, the imperial carriage went to Rehe; once arrived, an order was issued to draw two hundred thousand taels from the treasury to repair the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the Anglo-French allied armies invaded inland, the court fled to Rehe; once there, an order was issued to draw two hundred thousand taels from the treasury to repair the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 寶鋆以國用方亟，持不可。

translations.literal: Bao Yun, because state finances were urgent, maintained it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Yun, citing the state's urgent financial straits, maintained that it could not be done.

sentences.zh: 上怒，欲加嚴譴，會所管三山被掠，詔切責，降五品頂戴。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry and wished to impose severe censure; just then the three hills under his charge were plundered, and an edict sharply rebuked him; he was reduced to fifth-rank hat button.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was angry and wished to impose severe censure; just then the three hills under his charge were plundered, and an edict sharply rebuked him and reduced him to a fifth-rank hat button.

sentences.zh: 踰月後，以巡防勞勚，復之，兼鑲紅旗護軍統領，复兼署正紅旗漢軍都統、左翼前鋒統領。

translations.literal: After more than a month, for meritorious labor in patrol defense, he was restored; concurrently commander of the Bordered Red Banner guards, again concurrently acting commander of the Plain Red Banner Han Army and commander of the Left Vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a month, for meritorious labor in patrol defense, he was restored; he was made concurrently commander of the Bordered Red Banner guards, and again concurrently acting commander of the Plain Red Banner Han Army and commander of the Left Vanguard.

sentences.zh: 十一年，文宗崩於行在。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Emperor Wenzong died at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Emperor Wenzong died at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 十月，穆宗回京，命在軍機大臣上行走，並充總理各國事務大臣。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Emperor Muzong returned to the capital; ordered to serve on the Grand Council and appointed a minister for managing affairs of all nations.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Emperor Muzong returned to the capital; Bao Yun was ordered to serve on the Grand Council and appointed a minister for managing affairs of all nations.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，擢戶部尚書。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, promoted to minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he was promoted to minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 二年，奏劾壽莊公主府首領太監張玉蒼出言無狀，嚴旨逮訊，玉蒼治如律。

translations.literal: In the second year, memorialized impeaching Zhang Yucang, chief eunuch of the Prince Shouzhuang's mansion, for impertinent speech; a stern edict ordered arrest and interrogation; Yucang was punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he memorialized impeaching Zhang Yucang, chief eunuch of Prince Shouzhuang's mansion, for impertinent speech; a stern edict ordered his arrest and interrogation, and Yucang was punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 三年，命大臣輪班進講治平寶鑑，寶鋆與焉。

translations.literal: In the third year, ministers were ordered to take turns lecturing on the Mirror of Governance and Pacification; Bao Yun was among them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year ministers were ordered to take turns lecturing on the Mirror of Governance and Pacification, and Bao Yun was among them.

sentences.zh: 江寧克復，以翊贊功，加太子少保，賜花翎。

translations.literal: When Jiangning was recovered, for assisting merit, made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangning was recovered, for assisting merit he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and granted the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 四年，命佩帶內務府印鑰。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, ordered to carry the seal and keys of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was ordered to carry the seal and keys of the Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 尋以樞務事繁，請解內務府大臣職，允之。

translations.literal: Soon, because Grand Council duties were numerous, he asked to be relieved of Imperial Household superintendent; permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, because Grand Council duties were numerous, he asked to be relieved of his post as Imperial Household superintendent, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 自設立總理各國事務衙門，始求通知外國語言文字，置同文館，肄習西學，廷臣每以為非。

translations.literal: Since the establishment of the Zongli Yamen for managing affairs of all nations, they first sought knowledge of foreign languages and scripts, established the Tongwen Guan, and studied Western learning—court ministers often regarded this as wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Since the establishment of the Zongli Yamen, the court first sought knowledge of foreign languages and scripts, established the Tongwen Guan, and undertook Western learning—measures many court ministers regarded as misguided.

sentences.zh: 六年，都察院代奏職員楊廷熙上書請撤同文館，語涉恭親王及寶鋆等專擅挾持，於是寶鋆偕恭親王請罷直候查辦，溫詔慰留，勉以不避嫌怨，勿因浮言推諉。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Yang Tingxi, a staff member of the Censorate submitting by proxy, memorialized asking to abolish the Tongwen Guan, language touching Prince Gong and Bao Yun and others for monopolizing and controlling power; thereupon Bao Yun together with Prince Gong asked to leave council duty pending investigation; a warm edict comforted and retained them, urging them not to avoid resentment and not to shirk duties because of idle talk.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Yang Tingxi, a Censorate staff member submitting by proxy, memorialized asking to abolish the Tongwen Guan, language touching Prince Gong and Bao Yun and others for monopolizing and controlling power; thereupon Bao Yun together with Prince Gong asked to leave council duty pending investigation. A warm edict comforted and retained them, urging them not to avoid resentment and not to shirk duty because of idle talk.

sentences.zh: 七年，直東捻匪肅清，加軍功二級。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, when bandits in Zhili and the east were pacified, granted two grades of military merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, when bandits in Zhili and the east were pacified, he was granted two grades of military merit.

sentences.zh: 十一年，調吏部。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, transferred to Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 穆宗大婚禮成，加太子太保。

translations.literal: When Emperor Muzong's grand wedding was completed, made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Muzong's grand wedding was completed, he was made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十二年，兼翰林院掌院學士，以吏部尚書協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, concurrently chancellor of the Hanlin Academy, associate grand secretary as minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was made concurrently chancellor of the Hanlin Academy and associate grand secretary while serving as minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 尋調兵部，拜體仁閣大學士，管理吏部。

translations.literal: Soon transferred to War, invested as grand secretary of the Hall for Embodying Benevolence, managing Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to the Ministry of War, invested as grand secretary of the Hall for Embodying Benevolence, and put in charge of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 光緒三年，晉武英殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the third year of Guangxu, promoted to grand secretary of the Hall of Martial Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Guangxu he was promoted to grand secretary of the Hall of Martial Splendor.

sentences.zh: 四年，回疆肅清，被優敘。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, when the Muslim border regions were pacified, received special commendation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, when the Muslim border regions were pacified, he received special commendation.

sentences.zh: 寶鋆自同治初年預樞務，偕文祥和衷翊贊，通達政體，知人讓善，恭親王資其襄助，至是朝列漸分門戶。

translations.literal: From the early Tongzhi years Bao Yun took part in council affairs, working in harmony with Wen Xiang to assist; he understood the body politic, knew men and yielded to the good; Prince Gong relied on his assistance; by now court ranks gradually divided into factions.
translations.idiomatic: From the early Tongzhi years Bao Yun took part in council affairs, working in harmony with Wen Xiang to assist the throne; he understood the body politic, knew men and yielded to the good, and Prince Gong relied on his help—yet by now court ranks were gradually dividing into factions.

sentences.zh: 文祥既歿，議論益紛，編修何金壽因旱災劾樞臣不職，請加訓責，詔斥恭親王、寶鋆等目擊時艱，毫無補救，嚴議革職，加恩改留任。

translations.literal: After Wen Xiang died, opinions grew more confused; compiler He Jinshou, because of drought, impeached council ministers for neglect of duty and asked that they be rebuked; an edict reprimanded Prince Gong, Bao Yun, and others for witnessing the times' hardship without remedy, sternly deliberated dismissal, and by grace changed to retention in office.
translations.idiomatic: After Wen Xiang died, opinion grew more confused; compiler He Jinshou, citing drought, impeached the council ministers for neglect of duty and asked that they be rebuked. An edict reprimanded Prince Gong, Bao Yun, and others for witnessing the times' hardship without remedy, sternly deliberated dismissal, and by grace changed the penalty to retention in office.

sentences.zh: 五年，以題穆宗神主，加太子太傅，復以實錄告成，推恩其子景灃晉秩郎中，侄景星賜舉人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, for inscribing Emperor Muzong's spirit tablet, made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent; again when the Veritable Record was completed, extended grace: his son Jingfeng was promoted to director, his nephew Jingxing granted juren status.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, for inscribing Emperor Muzong's spirit tablet, he was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent; when the Veritable Record was completed, grace was extended—his son Jingfeng was promoted to director, and his nephew Jingxing was granted juren status.

sentences.zh: 七年，庶子陳寶琛以星變陳言，專劾寶鋆，請仿漢災異策免三公故事，立予罷斥。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, mentor Chen Baochen, citing celestial anomalies, memorialized specifically impeaching Bao Yun, asking to follow the Han precedent of dismissing the Three Dukes at calamity and omens, and immediately remove him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year mentor Chen Baochen, citing celestial anomalies, memorialized specifically impeaching Bao Yun and asking that the Han precedent of dismissing the Three Dukes at calamity and omens be followed and that he be immediately removed.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「寶鋆在軍機大臣上行走有年，尚無過失。

translations.literal: Edict: 'Bao Yun has served on the Grand Council for many years and has not yet had faults.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: 'Bao Yun has served on the Grand Council for many years and has had no faults.

sentences.zh: 陳寶琛謂其畏難巧卸，瞻徇情面，亦不能確有所指。

translations.literal: Chen Baochen says he shrinks from difficulty and shrewdly shifts blame, shows favoritism—yet cannot point to anything definite.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baochen says he shrinks from difficulty and shrewdly shifts blame and shows favoritism—yet cannot point to anything definite.

sentences.zh: 惟既有此奏，自平時與王大臣等議事未能和衷共濟，致啟人言。

translations.literal: Only because this memorial exists, in ordinary times in deliberation with princes and ministers he has failed to harmonize hearts and work together, opening the way to talk.
translations.idiomatic: Only because this memorial exists, in ordinary deliberations with princes and ministers he has failed to harmonize hearts and work together, opening the way to talk.

sentences.zh: 該大學士受恩深重，精力尚健，自當恪矢公忠，勉圖報稱，務宜殫精竭慮，力戒因循積習，用副委任。

translations.literal: This grand secretary has received deep grace; his vigor is still strong; he should strictly uphold public loyalty, strive to repay kindness, exhaust mind and thought, forcefully eschew habitual procrastination, to fulfill the commission.
translations.idiomatic: This grand secretary has received deep grace and his vigor is still strong; he should strictly uphold public loyalty, strive to repay that grace, exhaust mind and thought, forcefully eschew habitual procrastination, and fulfill the commission entrusted to him.

sentences.zh: 十年三月，軍機大臣自恭親王以下同日斥罷，詔：「寶鋆入直最久，責備宜嚴，姑念年老，特錄前勞，全其末路，以原品休致。

translations.literal: Third month of the tenth year, Grand Councilors from Prince Gong downward were dismissed on the same day; edict: 'Bao Yun has entered council duty longest; censure should be strict; for now considering his old age, specially recording his former service, sparing his last years, permitted to retire at original rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the tenth year the Grand Councilors from Prince Gong downward were dismissed on the same day. An edict said: 'Bao Yun has served in council longest; censure should be strict; yet considering his old age, his former service is specially recorded, his last years are spared, and he is permitted to retire at his original rank.

sentences.zh: 」十二年，皇太后懿旨加恩，改以大學士致仕，賞食半俸。

translations.literal: ' In the twelfth year, by empress dowager rescript grace was added: changed to retirement as grand secretary, granted half salary.
translations.idiomatic: ' In the twelfth year, by empress dowager rescript grace was added: his retirement was changed to that of a grand secretary, and he was granted half salary.

sentences.zh: 寶鋆退休後，時偕恭親王居西山遊覽唱和。

translations.literal: After Bao Yun retired, he sometimes joined Prince Gong dwelling at the Western Hills, touring and composing in mutual response.
translations.idiomatic: After Bao Yun retired, he sometimes joined Prince Gong in dwelling at the Western Hills, touring and composing in mutual response.

sentences.zh: 年逾八十，恩賚猶及。

translations.literal: Past eighty years, imperial gifts still reached him.
translations.idiomatic: Past eighty years of age, imperial gifts still reached him.

sentences.zh: 十七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he died.

sentences.zh: 遺疏入，詔褒其「忠清亮直，練達老成」，贈太保，祀賢良祠，擢子景灃四品京堂，賜孫廕桓舉人，遣貝勒載瀅奠醊，飾終之典，視在位無所減，諡文靖。

translations.literal: His death memorial entered; an edict praised him as 'loyal, pure, bright, and straight, experienced and seasoned'; posthumously made Grand Preceptor, worship at Shrine of Worthies, son Jingfeng promoted to fourth-rank capital official, grandson Yin Huan granted juren, Prince Zaiying sent to offer libations, funeral honors none diminished from those in office, posthumous title Wenjing.
translations.idiomatic: His death memorial entered court; an edict praised him as 'loyal, pure, bright, and straight, experienced and seasoned.' He was posthumously made Grand Preceptor and entered for worship at the Shrine of Worthies; his son Jingfeng was promoted to fourth-rank capital official, his grandson Yin Huan was granted juren status, Prince Zaiying was sent to offer libations, funeral honors were none diminished from those in office, and his posthumous title was Wenjing.

sentences.zh: 子景灃，官至廣州將軍，卒，諡誠慎。

translations.literal: His son Jingfeng rose to General of Guangzhou; on death, posthumous title Chengshen.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jingfeng rose to General of Guangzhou; on his death his posthumous title was Chengshen.

sentences.zh: 孫廕桓，光緒二十四年進士，歷官國子監司業，改乾清門頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: Grandson Yin Huan, jinshi of the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu, served as vice director of the Imperial Academy, changed to chief guard of the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Yin Huan, a jinshi of the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu, served as vice director of the Imperial Academy and was later changed to chief guard of the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 論曰：咸、同之間，內憂外患，岌岌不可終日。

translations.literal: Commentary: Between Xianfeng and Tongzhi, inner troubles and outer peril left the realm teetering day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: Between the Xianfeng and Tongzhi reigns, inner troubles and outer peril left the realm teetering day by day.

sentences.zh: 文慶倡言重用漢臣，俾曾國籓、胡林翼等得展經猷，以建中興之業，其功甚偉。

translations.literal: Wen Qing advocated employing Han ministers, enabling Zeng Guofan, Hu Linyi, and others to deploy their statecraft and build the Restoration—great was his merit.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Qing advocated employing Han ministers, enabling Zeng Guofan, Hu Linyi, and others to deploy their statecraft and build the Restoration—great was his merit.

sentences.zh: 文祥、寶鋆襄贊恭親王，和輯邦交，削平寇亂。

translations.literal: Wen Xiang and Bao Yun assisted Prince Gong, harmonized foreign relations, and quelled bandit turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Xiang and Bao Yun assisted Prince Gong, harmonized foreign relations, and quelled bandit turmoil.

sentences.zh: 文祥尤力任艱鉅，公而忘私，為中外所倚賴，而朝議未一，猶不能盡其規略；

translations.literal: Wen Xiang especially bore heavy burdens, forgetting self for the public, relied upon at home and abroad; yet court opinion was not united, and he could not fully carry out his plans;
translations.idiomatic: Wen Xiang especially bore heavy burdens, forgetting self for the public, and was relied upon at home and abroad; yet court opinion was not united, and he could not fully carry out his plans;

sentences.zh: 晚年密陳大計，於數十年馭外得失，洞如觀火，一代興亡之龜鑑也。

translations.literal: In his last years he secretly laid out grand strategy; on decades of gains and losses in managing foreigners, clear as watching fire—a tortoise mirror of one generation's rise and fall.
translations.idiomatic: In his last years he secretly laid out grand strategy; on decades of gains and losses in managing foreign powers, he saw as clearly as watching fire—a tortoise mirror of one generation's rise and fall.

sentences.zh: 寶鋆明達同之，貞毅不及，遂無以鎮紛囂而持國是。

translations.literal: Bao Yun was equally clear-sighted, but did not match him in steadfast integrity, and thus could not quell clamor and uphold the national course.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Yun was equally clear-sighted, but did not match him in steadfast integrity, and thus could not quell clamor and uphold the national course.

sentences.zh: 如文祥者，洵社稷臣哉！

translations.literal: A man like Wen Xiang—truly a minister of the altars of soil and grain!
translations.idiomatic: A man like Wen Xiang—truly a minister of the altars of soil and grain!
